speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with increasing yellow discoloration of your eyes and skin. To determine the cause of this jaundice, how long has the discoloration been visible, and was the baby feeding well and passing stool normally?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Milk Jaundice. The clinical picture of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant presenting with worsening jaundice after an initial drop (evidenced by weight gain from 3066g to 3200g) is classic for this condition. Please proceed with a Direct Bilirubin and Total Bilirubin level to confirm levels and ensure they are within the safe zone for phototherapy or observation.
